registered: before the first ledger row; the authoritative time is the git commit that adds this file
ledger: reports/model_bc_forward/ledger.jsonl (git-ignored, local, append-only, sha256 hash-chained; scripts/run_local_bc_pipeline.py writes it, scripts/score_bc_forward_ledger.py reads it)
validity: A row counts only if it is the first row for (variant, market, target), its chain hash verifies, it was issued before 09:00 KST of the target session, and its asof close and target close are stored in index_eod. Missed or blocked days are simply absent; nothing is back-filled.
ci_note: Bonferroni over the three forward tests per market (1 - 0.05/3), paired moving-block bootstrap, block 10, 2000 draws, seed 42.
sample_size_basis: n needed to detect the 2026 retrospective effect with 80% power at the Bonferroni level, from the 2026 per-event bootstrap SE (reports/model_c_kospi_20261125/eval_run2/scores.json): KOSPI K4 vs coin -0.056 (SE 0.026 at n=80) -> about 184 extreme days; WB7 vs previous close -15.8 points (SE 3.6 at n=218) -> about 116 sessions; WB3 vs up-rate -0.023 (SE 0.010 at n=218) -> about 440 sessions.
interim_safety: At 40 matured rows of any test, stop recording that variant if its mean loss difference vs its first comparator is worse by more than 0.02 Brier (direction) or 5 index points (close). This look makes no efficacy claim.
decision: At decision_n matured rows: pass only if every listed comparison's CI upper bound is below 0 and the ECE limit holds. A pass still needs independent ML/risk review; the PM cannot approve alone. KOSDAQ tests are monitor-only unless KOSDAQ passed the retrospective gate for that variant.
